name: Summit AZ - Search Atlas Audit 2026-07-20
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-07-20

# Summary
Four-page SEO and technical audit prepared by TAG from Search Atlas/OTTO plus GSC (Search Atlas audit #120252, crawl of 192 pages completed Jul 5).

# Verdicts
- Link testing: NEEDS WORK. 11 broken 4xx links, 13 redirects, 169 internal links that redirect (across 155 pages), 4 orphan pages, 12 pages with too few internal links.
- Responsiveness: HEALTHY layout at 1280px and 375px. Mobile performance is the real issue: 181 non-WebP images, 123 large-DOM pages, 19 images over 100 KB, 11 JS files over 300 KB, compression off.
- Indexability: HEALTHY. 159 indexable, 33 not (23 non-200, 10 X-Robots noindex, 1 meta noindex). Sitemap verified Success in GSC (170 pages, read Jul 18).
- Organic: UNDERPERFORM. 90 days: 122 clicks, 57,540 impressions. Domain Power 10 caps rankings on page 3.

# Top 3 actions
1. Repoint the 169 redirecting internal links and fix the 11 broken links.
2. Push the Tempe page (position about 23 with 20K impressions).
3. Authority building.
